messages.subject: CPU host-only adapter v2 source ready
messages.body: Added only six lines to the existing opt-in LLVM adapter, appending private CXX-only -fno-sycl to the four reviewed CPU targets, and delivered v2 Markdown, JSON and immutable-base patch artifacts. Source inspection found 28 affected CXX commands and six unchanged C commands with no configured CPU variants; all 198 historical files, 246 other tracked validation/report files and 49 vendor plus 1390 llama dependency files are preserved. Status remains SOURCE_ONLY_UNSAFE_TO_RUN: Main must review the patch, regenerate all commands and own all builds and later provider, numerical, physical262144, RESTORE and historical600 gates.
